analogy: q0,q2 = Casimir plates; q1 = gap mode; Z0Z2 = direct cavity coupling; Z0Z1Z2 = mode-aligned tripartite binding. Boundary line = physical chip edge.
guidance: Use depth sunscreen @ θ* for Casimir ZZZ binding (tripartite correlator). Trotter evolution under full Casimir H may still favor bare — check verdicts. Interior cavity lines outperform boundary plate-edge lines on Willow.

interior_depth_binding.notes: Casimir ZZZ binding @ θ*=22.49°: |ΔZZZ|=0.784 (cavity_interior line). Tripartite term captures mode-aligned plate coupling.

boundary_depth_binding.notes: Casimir ZZZ binding @ θ*=22.49°: |ΔZZZ|=0.460 (plate_edge line). Tripartite term captures mode-aligned plate coupling.
